text:
About The Job
vooy is hiring, and Harper, an AI career agent, is on your side of the table. Skip the application form: talk to Harper for a few minutes, and it puts your profile directly in front of vooy's founders. 👉 Start with Harper
Why Now
AI is moving from giving answers to finishing the job. In September, Instinct raised $1B at a $10B valuation for an agent that books, buys and cancels things for you (TechCrunch). But in Asia, global agents stop at the last step: most everyday services (delivery, reservations, payments, transit) have no public API. Ask one for a samgyeopsal place near Gangnam Station for four, right now, and you get three recommendations. Ask vooy, and it joins the waitlist and calls your taxi.
Job Title
Product Designer
Level
4+ years preferred. AI tool experience is not required (we'll give you the tools). What we look at: app design systems you've built and run, and how well you've turned a brand into UI.
Salary
Top-of-market salary + stock options. Unlimited LLM and agent usage.
Location
Seoul (Gangnam). On-site, full-time.
What vooy Is
The consumer agent that gets things done in Asia. It lives in the messenger you already use: send one sentence, and vooy works across six apps until it's done. In a group chat, everyone's vooy coordinates with the others to find a time and book the table. vooy already reaches 753 APIs across 113 Asian services and is expanding across Korea, Japan, Thailand, Taiwan, Singapore and the UAE. Incubated by Hashed.
What You'll Do
Design how a task that takes time, and sometimes fails, feels: in progress, waiting, needs your OK, done, failed
Design agents in a group chat: four friends, four vooys, one dinner booked
Build one design system across the whole app, and translate vooy's brand into a UI language
Work with a character system of 1,280 vooy states (16 bodies × 10 colors × 8 states) that change expression and motion with what the agent is doing
Own a core user flow from observation to launch, and explain the next priority with before-and-after behavior
Who You Are
You have built and run an app design system
You turn a brand into a UI language with real craft
You care how an agent's waiting, asking and failing moments feel to the person on the other side
How vooy Works
Everyone works with their own agent. In the last 30 days, people and agents shipped 4,123 PRs together, with review agents, metrics agents and a self-improving test loop.
How This Works
Harper is an AI career agent on your side, free for candidates.
Talk to Harper for 5 minutes. No resume form.
If you're a fit, your profile goes straight to vooy's founders, and only after you approve.
Not a fit? Harper keeps sending you roles you wouldn't find on your own.
한국어 요약
vooy는 메신저에서 시키면 일이 끝나 있는, 아시아의 개인 AI 에이전트를 만들어요. 해시드가 키운 팀이에요.
서울 강남 정규직, 업계 최상위 연봉과 스톡옵션, LLM 사용량 무제한이에요.
Harper와 5분만 이야기하면 창업자에게 바로 연결돼요.
